text.p: Incyte Pharmaceuticals Inc said Thursday it priced a public offering of 1.2 million shares at $67.00 a share.

All of the shares were sold by the company. The underwriters were granted an option to purchase an additional 177,713 shares to cover over-allotments. After the offering, Incyte will have about 11.8 million shares outstanding prior to any shares sold to cover over-allotments.
The shares were sold through an underwriting group managed by Hambrecht & Quist, Alex Brown & Sons Inc and Vector Securities International Inc.

Proceeds will be used for capital expenditures, strategic equity investments in joint ventures or businesses, acquisition of businesses, technologies and products that complement the company's business, and for working capital and general corporate purposes.
